verdict.rationale: Okta is an API-driven identity platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no such spec: probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The MCP server and the SCIM schema concept are adjacent features, not a downloadable machine-readable spec of Okta's own API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
